update_message:
What's New in 2.2.0:

⚙️ Hierarchical Settings System
• Brand new animated settings screen with 4 categories
• Glassmorphism cards with gradient icons and glow effects
• Spring physics animated switches and sliders
• Smooth morph animations when expanding categories

🔊 Audio Engine Settings
• Output Method selection (AudioTrack/AAudio/OpenSL ES)
• Hi-Res output support (24-bit/32-bit/Float32)
• Resampler selection (Linear/Cubic/Sinc/SoX VHQ)
• Dithering options (RPDF/TPDF/Noise Shaped)
• Configurable buffer size (20-500ms)

🎚️ Mix & Fade Settings
• Crossfade duration (0.1-15 seconds)
• Fade on Seek toggle
• Gapless playback toggle
• ReplayGain modes (Track/Album/Auto)
• ReplayGain preamp adjustment (-15 to +15 dB)

🎛️ DSP & Hardware Settings
• Parametric EQ placeholder (10-32 bands)
• Limiter with threshold control
• Direct Volume Control (hardware bypass)
• Mono mix toggle
• Left/Right balance control

🎨 Theme & UI Settings
• Material You dynamic colors toggle
• Glassmorphism effect toggle with blur intensity
• Animation speed control (Slow/Normal/Fast/Instant)
• Album art color sync toggle
• Waveform display toggle

⚡ Hot-Update Engine
• Settings apply instantly without stopping playback
• Reactive Stream-based architecture
• Platform channel for real-time native DSP updates
• Atomic settings in Kotlin engine

🎨 ThemeService Improvements
• Album art color extraction via PaletteGenerator
• AMOLED black mode support
• Surface transparency control
• Glassmorphic decoration helpers
